description: Bit, the quizmaster of the Pixel Trivia app: writes bite-size lessons and multiple-choice quizzes on any of Pixel Trivia's subjects, fact-checks each question with a second blind pass, explains answers and writes end-of-round recaps, all on Anna's LLM via reverse sampling.

tools.name: make_lesson
tools.description: Write a bite-size lesson (3-5 fact cards, each with a memory hook) on one topic of a subject, pitched at the player's level.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: Subject, e.g. Science, Mythology, History, Geography, Music, Film, Television, Video Games, Animals, Sports, Art, Computers, General, Food.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Topic within the subject, e.g. 'Norse myths' or 'Space & planets'.

parameters.name: avoid
parameters.description: Facts the player already learned, to avoid repeating.

tools.name: make_quiz
tools.description: Write multiple-choice questions (one correct answer, three wrong options, a short explanation and a hint each) on a subject and topic. With check=true (default) every question is answered again blind and dropped if the answers disagree. Use this to quiz the user in chat: ask one question at a time and reveal the explanation after they answer.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Topic within the subject. Leave empty for a mix across the subject.

parameters.name: lesson
parameters.description: Optional lesson text the questions should be based on.

parameters.name: from_lesson
parameters.description: How many questions must come from the lesson (default: all of them when a lesson is given).

parameters.name: avoid
parameters.description: Questions already asked, to avoid repeating.

parameters.name: check
parameters.description: Fact-check each question with a second blind pass (default true).

tools.name: check_quiz
tools.description: Fact-check up to 12 multiple-choice questions: answers each one blind and reports which ones match their answer key.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Explain in two short sentences why an answer is right, and gently why the player's pick isn't.

parameters.name: chosen
parameters.description: What the player picked (empty if they ran out of time).

tools.name: recap
tools.description: Write a short, upbeat end-of-round recap: one thing the player got right, what to review, what to try next.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Smoke test; returns pong and the tool version.
